semiconductor_relevance: High — Excillum specializes in advanced X-ray sources that are crucial for inspecting semiconductor components and advanced packaging.
summary: Excillum is a leader in X-ray technology, developing and manufacturing high-performance X-ray sources for industrial and laboratory applications. Their products are essential for inspecting next-generation electronic components, enhancing manufacturing processes in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Advanced X-ray sources for semiconductor inspection

regional_presence.Sweden: Excillum is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, where it has been innovating in X-ray technology since 2007.
